raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift" from intended workflows. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) features an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities, incorporating built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models, focusing on the "Work Graph" to expose resource inefficiencies and areas where AI can provide in-workflow assistance.
raw.one_liner: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to identify, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.

core_insight.source_excerpt: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. Enterprises often struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.
core_insight.if_wrong: If companies cannot or will not adopt a system that captures their detailed work patterns, or if the 'Work Graph' cannot effectively identify high-ROI opportunities, the value proposition of narma is significantly diminished.
core_insight.why_different: narma focuses on providing telemetry, intelligence, and an agent factory to leverage existing foundation models for precise AI automation deployment and measurement, rather than building new LLMs.

raw.evidence_of_stage: The founder has described the architectural concept and problem statement in detail but has made no mention of any developed product, users, or revenue.
raw.thesis: narma proposes an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: "Observe" (desktop sensors capturing work patterns), "Intelligence Layer" (a "Brain" detecting employee intent, business value, and workflow "drift"), and "Execution Layer" (an "Agent Factory" automatically generating and deploying AI agents for high-ROI opportunities with approval gates). This venture is for AI-first companies that struggle with identifying clear ROI for AI automation, lack telemetry to measure AI savings, and experience workflow drift. The venture aims to solve the severe and frequent problem of wasted resources and inefficient AI automation deployment. The founder appears to be building a growth startup, aiming to scale this enterprise solution. Based solely on the intake form, the venture seems to be at the idea stage, with the architecture and problem statement clearly defined but no mention of development or user acquisition. This venture complements existing foundation models by focusing on the "Work Graph" to identify and address inefficiencies, rather than competing with LLM development.
raw.what_makes_this_different: narma’s unique differentiator is its comprehensive, three-layered architecture that observes work patterns, intelligently detects intent and drift, and automatically deploys AI agents, all while leveraging existing foundation models and focusing on the "Work Graph" for precise ROI measurement and automation.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the prospect of providing AI-first companies with the tools to precisely identify and act on AI automation opportunities within their workflows, thereby solving critical issues of telemetry, ROI measurement, and workflow drift.
